COUNTRY-AWARE AI RISK OPERATIONS — PROJECT SUMMARY

Author: Alessio Carrà
Target: Senior product roles in AI, platform, risk, and operations at Remote
Format: Independent, synthetic, working product proposal
Live demo: https://bralca.github.io/remote-risk-check/?view=product&hire=oliver-uk
Source: https://github.com/bralca/remote-risk-check

PRODUCT
Atlas Robotics is hiring five people across Portugal, Germany, France, and the
United Kingdom. Company checks appear once. Country-aware decisions produce
exactly three ready cases, one customer action, and one specialist review.

SYSTEM
Remote-shaped evidence is normalized, minimized, assigned evidence IDs, checked
against deterministic country policy, and sent through a cost-aware router.
Standard cases use no generative model. Bounded document extraction uses a
lightweight model. Ambiguous or higher-exposure cases use advanced analysis and
specialist review. Invalid AI output or unknown policy fails safely.

ECONOMICS
One disclosed illustrative scenario compares a €12.00 manual baseline with a
€4.54 routed cost per safe decision, a rounded 62% reduction. These values are
not Remote operational data or a claimed Remote margin.

VISION
A bounded case agent may retrieve evidence, validate known requirements, send
approved follow-ups, update case state, and auto-clear complete policy-covered
cases. A human must own reserves, holds, rejections, freezes, high-exposure
uncertainty, and novel policy interpretation.

AUTHORITY MODEL
Policy decides standard outcomes. The agent performs routine orchestration.
People own consequential action.

All companies, employees, policies, messages, costs, and decisions are
fictional. Public API-mapped and conceptual internal inputs are labeled
separately. No live Remote data, model endpoint, or messaging integration is
used. This project is independent and not affiliated with Remote.
